metadata.title: SC-900 Concept Map Explorer
metadata.description: Authored concept graph mapping SC-900 security, identity, and compliance ideas to Microsoft services.

nodes.name: Security
nodes.definition: Security in SC-900 focuses on protecting identities, devices, workloads, and operations with layered controls that reduce risk and improve detection and response.

nodes.name: Identity
nodes.definition: Identity covers authentication, authorization, governance, and privileged access so the right people get the right access under the right conditions.

nodes.name: Compliance
nodes.definition: Compliance in SC-900 centers on understanding data, applying policy, meeting regulatory obligations, and proving control effectiveness during audits or investigations.

nodes.name: Shared Responsibility
nodes.definition: Cloud security is a shared model: Microsoft secures the platform, while customers still configure identities, data protection, devices, and governance correctly.

nodes.name: Zero Trust
nodes.definition: Zero Trust assumes breach and verifies every request explicitly using identity, device, workload, and data signals before granting or maintaining access.

nodes.name: Defense in Depth
nodes.definition: Defense in Depth layers preventive, detective, and corrective controls so a single failure does not expose the full environment.

nodes.name: CIA Triad
nodes.definition: Confidentiality, integrity, and availability provide the baseline lens for judging whether a control protects data and systems in the right way.

nodes.name: MFA
nodes.definition: Multifactor authentication strengthens sign-in by requiring more than a password, making stolen credentials much less useful to attackers.

nodes.name: Conditional Access
nodes.definition: Conditional Access evaluates signals like user risk, device state, app, and location to allow, block, or step up access in real time.

nodes.name: SIEM
nodes.definition: A SIEM centralizes log collection, correlation, and investigation so analysts can detect suspicious behavior across many systems.

nodes.name: SOAR
nodes.definition: SOAR connects detections to automated playbooks so common response steps can run faster, more consistently, and at larger scale.

nodes.name: Data Classification
nodes.definition: Data classification labels and organizes information by sensitivity so the business can apply the right retention, access, and protection policies.

nodes.name: DLP
nodes.definition: Data loss prevention detects sensitive content and helps stop it from being shared, copied, or exfiltrated in ways that violate policy.

nodes.name: Encryption at rest / in transit
nodes.definition: Encryption protects data while it is stored and while it moves between systems, reducing exposure if storage or traffic is intercepted.

nodes.name: Compliance Manager
nodes.definition: Compliance Manager translates regulations into assessments and improvement actions so teams can track progress against multiple frameworks.

nodes.name: eDiscovery
nodes.definition: eDiscovery preserves, searches, and exports content needed for litigation, investigations, and regulatory response across Microsoft 365 data.

nodes.name: Privileged Access
nodes.definition: Privileged access focuses on limiting who can perform high-impact actions, reducing standing access, and monitoring administrative activity closely.

nodes.name: Identity Governance
nodes.definition: Identity governance manages lifecycle, access reviews, approvals, and entitlement visibility so access remains appropriate over time.

nodes.name: Microsoft Entra ID
nodes.definition: Microsoft Entra ID is the cloud identity foundation for users, groups, apps, and access policies across Microsoft 365, Azure, and connected apps.

nodes.name: Microsoft Entra ID Protection
nodes.definition: Entra ID Protection scores risky sign-ins and users so organizations can trigger MFA, password reset, or blocking based on identity risk.

nodes.name: Microsoft Entra Permissions Management
nodes.definition: Entra Permissions Management discovers and reduces excessive cloud permissions, helping teams move toward least privilege across Azure, AWS, and GCP.

nodes.name: Microsoft Intune
nodes.definition: Microsoft Intune manages device compliance, app protection, and endpoint configuration so access policies can trust device posture.

nodes.name: Microsoft Defender XDR
nodes.definition: Microsoft Defender XDR correlates signals across endpoint, identity, email, and cloud workloads to surface higher-fidelity incidents and automate response.

nodes.name: Microsoft Defender for Endpoint
nodes.definition: Defender for Endpoint provides endpoint protection, EDR, investigation, and vulnerability insights across desktop, server, and mobile platforms.

nodes.name: Microsoft Defender for Cloud
nodes.definition: Defender for Cloud combines posture management and workload protection to identify configuration risk, threats, and compliance gaps across cloud resources.

nodes.name: Microsoft Defender for Cloud Apps
nodes.definition: Defender for Cloud Apps adds SaaS visibility, session controls, and anomaly detection to reduce shadow IT and risky data movement in cloud apps.

nodes.name: Microsoft Defender for Identity
nodes.definition: Defender for Identity watches on-premises Active Directory behavior to detect credential theft, lateral movement, and identity-based attacks.

nodes.name: Microsoft Sentinel
nodes.definition: Microsoft Sentinel is Microsoft's cloud-native SIEM and SOAR platform for ingesting logs, correlating detections, and orchestrating response with playbooks.

nodes.name: Microsoft Purview Data Governance
nodes.definition: Purview Data Governance discovers, catalogs, and classifies data assets so teams can understand lineage, ownership, and sensitivity across environments.

nodes.name: Microsoft Purview Data Loss Prevention
nodes.definition: Purview DLP applies policy across Microsoft 365 and endpoints to detect sensitive content and block, warn, or audit unsafe sharing actions.

nodes.name: Microsoft Purview Information Protection
nodes.definition: Purview Information Protection uses sensitivity labels and encryption so protection persists with files and emails after they are shared.

nodes.name: Microsoft Purview Insider Risk Management
nodes.definition: Purview Insider Risk Management identifies patterns associated with risky user behavior and supports investigation with privacy-aware workflows.

nodes.name: Microsoft Purview eDiscovery
nodes.definition: Purview eDiscovery helps legal and compliance teams place holds, search content, collect evidence, and export results for review.

nodes.name: Microsoft Purview Compliance Manager
nodes.definition: Purview Compliance Manager tracks assessment progress and control actions across frameworks such as GDPR, ISO 27001, and HIPAA.

nodes.name: Microsoft Priva
nodes.definition: Microsoft Priva supports privacy workflows such as subject rights requests and privacy risk review for organizations managing regulated personal data.
